headline: 2026 All-MLB Team: First and Second Team on the field
caption:
⭐ The 2026 All-MLB Team

The best players in baseball, position by position. The World Series champion Brewers lead the way with four selections, and Yordan Alvarez, Pete Crow-Armstrong and Bobby Witt Jr. headline the First Team.

First Team
C Gabriel Moreno (D-backs) · 1B Pete Alonso (Orioles) · 2B Brice Turang (Brewers) · 3B Junior Caminero (Rays) · SS Bobby Witt Jr. (Royals) · OF Jackson Chourio (Brewers), Pete Crow-Armstrong (Cubs), Fernando Tatis Jr. (Padres) · DH Yordan Alvarez (Astros)
SP Jacob Misiorowski (Brewers), Cam Schlittler (Yankees), Chris Sale (Braves), Dylan Cease (Blue Jays), Cristopher Sánchez (Phillies) · RP Mason Miller (Padres), Louis Varland (Blue Jays)

Second Team
C William Contreras (Brewers) · 1B Willson Contreras (Red Sox) · 2B Brandon Lowe (Pirates) · 3B Alex Bregman (Cubs) · SS Elly De La Cruz (Reds) · OF Randy Arozarena (Mariners), James Wood (Nationals), Jordan Walker (Cardinals) · DH Ben Rice (Yankees)
SP Yoshinobu Yamamoto (Dodgers), Tarik Skubal (Tigers/Dodgers), Sonny Gray (Red Sox), Drew Rasmussen (Rays), Jesús Luzardo (Phillies) · RP Bryan Baker (Rays), Cade Smith (Guardians)

➡️ Swipe for both teams on the field.
👉 Every 2026 MLB award winner via the link in our bio.
